Preflight Demo Program
DEMO-STATION-02
DOC-0039 2026-08-05
MEETING NOTES — Structures Desk Relief During the
Roster Gap
Date: 2026-08-05
Program: DEMO-PROGRAM-BETA
Attendees: PERSON-0028 for TEAM-0004; relief team's
coordinator; station roster clerk; duty chair.
Purpose: Arrange a substitute for the structures coordination
desk at DEMO-STATION-02. The working folder uses ISSUE-0076
and TASK-0199 as locating references.
Decisions
The relief team will provide desk coverage from 12:20 to
15:10, subject to the receiving coordinator's confirmation.
The roster clerk will keep the interval marked as a coverage
question until the substitute accepts it. A proposed name must
not make an uncovered interval disappear from the sheet.
The substitute receives the appointment diary,
attachment-location notes, and the next administrative action
for each discussion being handed over. The outgoing desk
retains a dated copy of the coverage arrangement. This meeting
allocates desk time rather than changing a task's assignee.
If the proposed substitute cannot attend, the duty chair names
a fallback role and records the revised contact time. The
chair's decision goes beside the original interval so the
returning coordinator can reconstruct the day's arrangements.
Action items
— Owner: Relief team's coordinator. Due: 2026-08-06 at 11:30.
Confirm the substitute and covered interval.
_ Owner: PERSON-0028. Due: 2026-08-06 at 12:00. Prepare the
appointment diary for the substitute.
D. Worker 0028
Demo Worker 0028, Demo Team 04
